purpose: Teach: 脚光/全盛期/迷走/イジメ/争奪/自尊心/趨勢/再犯

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品で脚光を浴びる時こそ謙虚でいろ
lines.en: When our company is in the spotlight with a new product, that's when we must be most humble.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clear articulation of each clause. Slight pause before 'humble'—the weight of the principle landing. Calm but commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の全盛期を支えた古参社員を大事にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we honor the veteran staff who built this company through its best years.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Steady, deliberate pacing. Slight emphasis on 'honor'—showing he understands the gravity. Quiet commitment in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、経営方針が迷走しないよう注意しろ
lines.en: Don't let our management direction lose its way.
lines.style: Sharp, direct instruction. Clipped edges on the key words. Lean forward slightly in the voice. No room for misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内イジメは絶対に許しません
lines.en: Understood. I will not tolerate workplace bullying under any circumstances.
lines.style: Firm resolve. Each word distinct and weighted. No hesitation or softening. The voice of someone making a clear stand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の市場争奪戦から逃げるな
lines.en: Don't retreat from the competitive battle in the market.
lines.style: Sharp, forceful. The word 'competitive' cuts cleanly. Forward momentum in the phrasing. No allowance for passivity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の自尊心を尊重した人事を行います
lines.en: Yes. I'll implement personnel decisions that respect our employees' dignity.
lines.style: Thoughtful confirmation. Slight elongation on 'respect'—it matters. Grounded, serious tone. The promise of someone thinking this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場の趨勢を読み続けろ
lines.en: Keep reading the market's movements without stopping.
lines.style: Insistent but not harsh. Steady rhythm. The emphasis on 'keep' and 'without stopping' shows vigilance as ongoing. Alert, focused delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の不正再犯防止策を整備します
lines.en: Yes. I will establish measures to prevent fraud recurrence among staff.
lines.style: Professional closure. Measured, careful articulation. The gravitas of 'establish' and 'prevent' land firmly. Ending note of finality and readiness.
